_note: Config-level study, not a walk-forward (owner 2026-11-10: why daily data, why not hourly / 15 minutes?). Fixed before running. Strategies: tsmom {lookbacks [14,28,56], top_n 12, target_vol 0.3} and xsmom {lookback 28}, on the Binance 82-coin set (the only universe with years of 1h bars on disk; survivor-biased, so read DIFFERENCES between rows, not levels) and on Hyperliquid 4h (2.3 y). Rows: bars 1d decide daily; bars 4h decide daily; bars 4h decide every 4h; bars 1h decide daily; bars 1h decide every 4h; bars 1h decide every hour. Reported: net Sharpe, return, turnover, cost per year (band 0.01). Decision rule: finer DECISIONS are worth building out (full-universe intraday data, intraday live loop) only if deciding every 4h or every hour raises net Sharpe by at least 0.15 over deciding daily on the same bars for BOTH strategies on Binance and does not lower it on Hyperliquid. Finer BARS with daily decisions are judged separately (same rule, 0.15). 15-minute bars are not run: Hyperliquid serves 52 days of them and the 1h row already shows the direction.
